desc:
Would You Rather: Football Fan Tower ⚽

Choose a door and become the ultimate Football Fan! ⚽
Every step is a choice: will you go Ronaldo... or Messi? Brazil... or Argentina?

🏆 Each door gives you something new — kits, auras, speed & jump boosts
💀 …or something that might completely ruin your run
🌍 Climb all the way to the top and prove you've got the best Football Fan style!

❤️ Like the game + join the group for extra perks!

Can you make it to the finish...?

--------------------------------
WARNING FOR ROBLOX:
This game is a fan-made parody, created for entertainment only. All names, faces, kits, and outfits are fictional and stylized — NOT real likenesses of any player, team, league, or brand. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any real athlete, club, or organization. Any resemblance is purely coincidental. Rights holders with concerns can contact us for review.
